raw_context:
Cognita Labs
does not make continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or sleep trackers
. Instead, they specialize in digital pulmonary and respiratory care solutions, creating FDA-cleared hardware and remote patient monitoring tools for asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
MedCity News
Cognita Labs Products
CapMedic
: A smart, FDA-cleared MDI inhaler cap that tracks usage frequency, timing, and technique while functioning as a home spirometer.
PulmoScan
: A portable Class II FDA-cleared airway impedance device built for fast testing in minimal training environments.
UltraSpiro
: An interactive coaching spirometer designed for precise patient use.
